description: Quorum-based human approval gate. Extends the base human-approval pattern with N-of-M semantics: required_approvers votes from an approver_allowlist, optional timeout_hours with on_timeout policy (escalate / reject / approve). Works over local FS or any fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://). Vote-by-file-drop: each approver writes <approval_dir>/<key>.<approver_id>.json. Composes with any downstream that reads asset_check results.

inputs.description: One upstream asset — passes through when quorum approves.

outputs.description: Gate asset with a 'quorum' asset_check that fails on pending/rejected — downstream blocks via AutomationCondition.eager().

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the value that passes through on approval.

approval_dir.label: Approval Directory
approval_dir.description: Local path or fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://). Cloud URIs recommended on Dagster+ Serverless.

required_approvers.label: Required Approvers
required_approvers.description: How many allowlisted approvers must vote the same way to open/close the gate.

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Approver IDs allowed to vote. Vote filename: <partition_key>.<approver_id>.json.

timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours
timeout_hours.description: Clock starts on first materialization. Omit to wait forever.

on_timeout.label: On Timeout
on_timeout.description: Timeout policy: escalate (stay pending, emit ERROR check), reject (auto-reject), approve (auto-approve — use with care).

escalate_contact.label: Escalate Contact
escalate_contact.description: Free-form (email, Slack handle, PagerDuty rotation ID) surfaced in the escalation-timeout check message.

default_approval_key.label: Default Approval Key
default_approval_key.description: Filename stem used when the asset is unpartitioned.

name: Multi-Approver Gate
